:::{#thm-noise-mean-zero}
#### The noise has population mean zero

Given $\newpredvar = \predvar$,
the [noise](#def-noise) $\noise$ has [population mean](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation) $0$:

$$
\E{\noise \mid \newpredvar = \predvar} = 0.
$$ {#eq-noise-mean-zero}

:::

::: proof
Take every expectation to be [conditional](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-cond-expectation) on $\newpredvar = \predvar$.
The value $\truemeanf{\predvar}$ is a constant given $\newpredvar = \predvar$.

$$
\ba
\E{\noise}
&= \E{\newoutvar - \truemeanf{\predvar}}
&& \text{(definition of the noise)} \\
&= \E{\newoutvar} - \truemeanf{\predvar}
&& \text{(linearity of expectation; a constant is its own mean)} \\
&= \truemeanf{\predvar} - \truemeanf{\predvar}
&& \text{(definition of the mean function)} \\
&= 0
&& \text{(} a - a = 0 \text{)}
\ea
$$

:::
